st: Falling off your bike in the age of ChatGPT

sec.p: I fell off my bike. Or rather, someone made me fall. Result: 30 days of forced sofa time and an AI deep-dive I hadn't planned.
We've also seen that AI is a “longa manus”, autonomous and able to do work for us (🎼 ff.119 Hands everywhere).

sec.t: ff.124.3 A family doctor (in your pocket)
sec.p: There are more examples online of artificial intelligence solving physical, real-world health problems. So much so that Reid Hoffman, co-founder of LinkedIn, talks about superagency:

sec.t: ff.124.4 ChatGPT, jack of all trades
sec.p: It also guided me through physio exercises, built a recovery plan for my Ironman in September (fingers crossed) and delivered a PhD-style review on using collagen + vitamin C to support bone regrowth.

rel: ff.109 A family doctor called AI
